affiliation_code_description:
This code is used if the organization is a central type organization (no group exemption) of a National,
Regional or Geographic grouping of organizations.

This code is used if the organization is an intermediate organization (no group exemption) of a
National, Regional or Geographic grouping of organizations (such as a state headquarters of a national
organization).

This code is used if the organization is an independent organization or an independent auxiliary
(i.e., not affiliated with a National, Regional, or Geographic grouping of organizations).

affiliation_code_definition: Parent of a group ruling (not a church)
affiliation_code_description:
This code is used if the organization is a parent (group ruling) and is not a church or 501(c)(1)
organization.

This code is used if the organization is a group exemption intermediate organization of a National,
Regional or Geographic grouping of organizations.
This code is used if the organization is a parent (group ruling) and is a church or 501(c)(1) organization.

affiliation_code_definition: Subordinate of a group ruling (also, group return)
affiliation_code_description: This code is used if the organization is a subordinate in a group ruling.
